I came to software not through a conventional path — I studied Life Sciences at Delhi University, where I learned to think in systems, observe patterns, and care deeply about how things actually work beneath the surface. That same curiosity now drives how I build software: with precision, with purpose, and with a bias toward things that last.

I work at Vibgyor, where I develop cutting-edge internal tools and client-facing software for the interior design industry. Outside of work, you'll find me deep in a Sherlock Holmes novel, sketching ideas in a notebook, or pushing a new experiment to GitHub.
